algorithm_description: Each pytest-collectable test (module-level 'test*' functions and 'test*' methods of 'Test*' or '*TestCase' classes, nested classes included) is fingerprinted as SHA-256 over ast.dump() of its decorators, arguments, return annotation and body with a leading docstring removed, plus its context: the class-level assignments of every enclosing class and the module-level assignments of names the test loads. Names bound inside the body (assignment, for, with, except and comprehension targets) are alpha-renamed in binding order; argument names are kept because fixture names are semantic. Test names, docstrings, comments, formatting and source positions are ignored. Tests that share a fingerprint form one body duplicate group, matched by member test ids; a group whose members all moved may reappear under new ids if it does not grow. Separately, one 'Class::test' qualified name defined in more than one file of the same directory forms a name collision group. Groups may only shrink.
